correctness.rationale: Block inversion gives exact hub/leaf and leaf/leaf offdiagonals. The exact Rademacher variance reduces to separable integer costs; a strict balancing exchange and increasing discrete differences prove every global minimizer, sharp threshold and counts. Fixed-cost large-star estimates prove the exact one-split ratio. A standard-library rational checker exhaustively verifies finite partitions and directly recomputes Green entries, totaling 367 assertions. Finite cases do not replace the all-parameter algebra.

value.rationale: The natural fixed-cost trace-probing design problem on a canonical heterogeneous graph gains a complete sharp screening phase classification and all optimal partitions. The asymptotic price of not redesigning partition classes is a nonvanishing (k-1)/(2k^2) fractional variance loss and 9/8 at the first refinement. This directly quantifies a practical reuse-versus-redesign tradeoff without claiming a general lower bound on other hierarchical estimators.
